race.comment: ZALI'S GIFT (7) has raced twice this prep and turned in decent performances after getting a long way out of her ground. Might fire up with the blinkers back on today. Expecting sharp improvement at this stage of the prep and she has the talent to take this out. BROWNING STREET (11) started at $51 on debut last time out but defied the market, rushing home into third over 1200m at this track. Will be tough to resist this time over an extra 200m. Five-year-old WARDIKCAR (2) returned from a seven-month spell and was lining up for only the third time when a close second over this course and distance recently. Likely improver who poses a genuine threat. LUNARIS (14) started favourite but was never in the hunt on debut over 1100m here last time. Should be far more effective out to this trip so don't sack her just yet. ROCKING IN VEGAS (1) has been in the money at nine of 19 runs, including an eyecatcher over 1200m here last start. A must for the exotics.
